title: Multiple Choice - Conversation Completion
description: Choose the correct response to complete the conversation.

questions.text:
Sophie: 'Congratulations on winning the youth leadership award last night!'
Daniel: '______________________________'
options: I appreciate your kind words, and I hope to drop out of the project soon.
Thank you so much, it was truly an impressive achievement for our team.
Thanks a lot, although the doctor said my biological parents were resting.
That is very kind of you, but we were carrying out attacks all afternoon.
questions.correct_answer: Thank you so much, it was truly an impressive achievement for our team.

questions.text:
Liam: 'Why is your older sister moving to Los Angeles this autumn?'
Chloe: '______________________________'
options: She intends to recover from cancer while volunteering in another county.
She hopes to rule an ancient kingdom near the southern coastal borders.
She is planning to construct a wartime field hospital for local medics.
She wants to work as an animator for a famous digital animation studio.
questions.correct_answer: She wants to work as an animator for a famous digital animation studio.

questions.text:
Hannah: 'How did you feel when you heard you passed the medical exam?'
Marcus: '______________________________'
options: I felt very exhausted because the army was preparing to defeat enemies.
I was wondering whether our grandparents had enjoyed a long marriage.
I was reading a biography when the headmaster asked me to leave school.
I was on cloud nine and could not stop smiling for the rest of the day.
questions.correct_answer: I was on cloud nine and could not stop smiling for the rest of the day.

questions.text:
Olivia: 'Do you want to visit the new historical theme park this Sunday?'
Ethan: '______________________________'
options: I cannot come along because my father is defending the national border.
I will pass because the surgeon is operating on the injured soldiers now.
I would love to join you because I really enjoy thrilling roller coasters.
I am not interested because that place was destroyed during the civil war.
questions.correct_answer: I would love to join you because I really enjoy thrilling roller coasters.

questions.text:
Lucas: 'Who inspired you to pursue a career in aerospace research?'
Grace: '______________________________'
options: A famous monarch who ruled over three different kingdoms in the north.
A humble volunteer who carried out unexpected attacks along the coast.
A young student who dropped out of secondary school during the winter.
A visionary astrophysicist who was designing lunar exploration modules.
questions.correct_answer: A visionary astrophysicist who was designing lunar exploration modules.

questions.text:
Noah: 'Could you recommend an inspiring book for my history presentation?'
Emma: '______________________________'
options: You can visit the local tourist attraction before the ticket counter closes.
You might ask the biological parents why their daughter changed her school.
You should read this biography of a scientist who devoted her life to peace.
You ought to watch this blockbuster movie about a fictional alien invader.
questions.correct_answer: You should read this biography of a scientist who devoted her life to peace.

questions.text:
Ava: 'Your grandparents look so joyful in their wedding anniversary photograph!'
Ben: '______________________________'
options: Indeed, they were fighting in a resistance war when the town was flooded.
Yes, they have had a long marriage filled with mutual trust and harmony.
Certainly, they decided to drop out of college before meeting each other.
Yes, they were admitted to a field hospital shortly after moving abroad.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, they have had a long marriage filled with mutual trust and harmony.

questions.text:
Mia: 'How does Professor Bradley manage to master five different languages?'
Jack: '______________________________'
options: He is extremely well educated and has spent decades studying linguistics.
He was on top of the world when the laboratory equipment arrived by rail.
He was producing an animated cartoon series when his cousin phoned him.
He decided to adopt a rescue puppy while traveling through South America.
questions.correct_answer: He is extremely well educated and has spent decades studying linguistics.

questions.text:
James: 'How did our regional basketball team defeat the defending champions?'
Lily: '______________________________'
options: Our school was establishing a field hospital beside the athletic fields.
Our players were visiting a famous tourist attraction across the capital.
Our coach was a tactical genius who adjusted the formation at halftime.
Our captain decided to attend school in another district after the match.
questions.correct_answer: Our coach was a tactical genius who adjusted the formation at halftime.

questions.text:
Zoe: 'I heard that Mr. Henderson passed away peacefully last weekend.'
Leo: '______________________________'
options: Yes, his death is a huge loss to everyone in our community who knew him.
Certainly, he showed remarkable determination while running the marathon.
Yes, he was working as a film producer when the blockbuster debuted online.
Indeed, he was celebrated as a military genius during the royal tournament.
questions.correct_answer: Yes, his death is a huge loss to everyone in our community who knew him.
